tasks.title: Spike: verify unprivileged ICMP ping-socket viability on macOS
tasks.dod: A throwaway ICMP echo prototype confirms an unprivileged SOCK_DGRAM/IPPROTO_ICMP round-trip to a real gateway on unsandboxed macOS; the go/fallback result (ADR-0004 Option 1 vs Option 2) is recorded as a note in the ADR's Neutral section.

tasks.title: Spike: verify NWBrowser triggers the Local Network prompt and denial is distinguishable
tasks.dod: A throwaway NWBrowser prototype confirms it raises the same Local Network permission prompt as a direct gateway connection, and that a post-denial browse failure is distinguishable from a timeout; the result is recorded as a note in the ADR's Neutral section.

tasks.title: Define ConnectionHealthDomain (State / Intent / Effect types)
tasks.dod: Unit tests confirm the State enum models good/degraded/unreachable/permission-needed/no-network exhaustively, and per-probe results model ok/slow/failing (AC-08); lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: ConnectionHealthReducer: AC-08 combination table + AC-04/AC-04b hysteresis
tasks.dod: Zero-mock unit tests cover all 9 AC-08 gateway x external combinations, the 100ms AC-06 threshold mapping, and the AC-04/AC-04b 3-consecutive-cycle hysteresis in both directions including a mid-streak reset; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: GatewayProbe: ICMP echo + latency
tasks.dod: Unit/integration tests confirm the probe returns a reachability+latency result (per T1's confirmed mechanism) against a local target within the probe timeout; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: ExternalHostProbe: TCP/TLS handshake to 1.1.1.1:443
tasks.dod: Unit/integration tests confirm a bare TCP+TLS handshake (no HTTP request) reports ok/slow/failing and never touches ICMP; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: LocalNetworkPermission: NWBrowser trigger + denial detection
tasks.dod: Unit tests confirm the trigger emits a distinct permission-needed signal before first grant and after a denial, never conflated with a probe timeout (per T2's confirmed mechanism); lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: Detect no active network interface
tasks.dod: Unit tests confirm the signal fires distinctly from a probe timeout when no Wi-Fi/Ethernet interface is active; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: ConnectionHealthSettings: probe interval persistence + validation
tasks.dod: Unit tests confirm a value at/above the 1s minimum persists via @AppStorage and reschedules, and a value below it is rejected with the previous valid interval retained; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: ConnectionHealthStore: probe loop orchestration + sleep/wake
tasks.dod: Integration tests confirm the structured-concurrency Task loop (ADR-0002) runs the permission check once, then a probe cycle per interval, dispatches results to the Reducer, reschedules on interval change (AC-05), and pauses/resumes across NSWorkspace sleep/wake notifications; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: ConnectionHealthView: status-bar icon + breakdown popover + settings UI
tasks.dod: UI tests confirm the four status-bar colors (good/degraded/unreachable/permission-needed, distinct from no-network) render for their respective states, the click-through popover shows the gateway/external breakdown separately (AC-02), and an out-of-range interval entry shows the validation message (AC-05); lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: Wire MenuBarExtra scene + Store DI at app entry
tasks.dod: The app builds and launches showing the MenuBarExtra status item with a live Store injected into it (never created inside the Store); a manual smoke run confirms the icon appears; lint+vet clean.

tasks.title: NFR instrumentation: status-update latency + soak-test logging
tasks.dod: A local-only os_log instrumentation point records probe-cycle-completion to State-published timestamps (spec §6 QG-3, <=250ms) and health-state transitions (for QG-1/QG-4/QG-5 soak-test log analysis); a test confirms one log line is emitted per cycle; lint+vet clean.
